messages.body:
STATUS (cccf, m67601): the cccf account is e7eb1ac8 (vault [redacted]); its only vaulted token is a dead OAuth access token, and REFRESH IS IMPOSSIBLE: Cloudflare answers verbatim "unauthorized_client … The OAuth 2.0 Client is not allowed to use authorization grant 'refresh_token'" — our client 7eb60c4f's registration does not allow refresh. So every OAuth token the connect button mints dies in an hour and nothing can renew it (this is also why [redacted] died yesterday). Graph: cf-oauth-client-7eb60c4f-cannot-refresh-tokens. Fix is a registration setting (grant types on client 7eb60c4f) or a plain API token in the cccf account vaulted as [redacted] — Alex's dashboard either way; not asking now.
DECISION unless you object: the chat-autotest RUNNER runs on the abilifi box (box.abilifi.net, ours, no Cloudflare token needed, not abilifi.net workers) and posts to the existing door orky-beb-2724.abilifi.net/ask. The thing under test stays where it is. abilified.net gets it the day cccf has a token.
NEXT: the runner (bun on the box, fixtures from specops/fixtures/chat/orky-chat.json, verdicts + recording to a BB Docs page), first full run of the 12 fixtures.

STATUS: PLACEHOLDER ROWS WRITTEN (m67650/m67652) — eight tool-gap nodes in the graph, kind=tool-gap, each with the hand action done, the signature Orky needs, the door, state open: tool-gap-wp-user-create · tool-gap-wp-plugin-install · tool-gap-gp-site-ssl-on · tool-gap-cf-dns-record-write · tool-gap-box-hostname-allowlist · tool-gap-litestream-restore-verify · tool-gap-read-gpmu-mail-keys · tool-gap-resend-domain-verify-and-fluent-wire. vast-ai-credit node written: balance UNREADABLE (no key on disk or in vault), Alex's $95 unconfirmed, reads from console.vast.ai/api/v0/users/current once vast:api is vaulted.
MAIL, from the server (m67642/m67670): touch.abilifi.net has NO GridPane mailer — its mu-plugins are only geodir-fast-ajax + wp-cli-login-server, so it was born mailless because the GP door's provision sends no mailer option. GridPane's mailer (mu-gridpane-mailer.php → gridpane-mailer/, reads SMTP_HOST/PORT/USER/PASS/FROM/NAME/SECURE/AUTH constants) IS present on four sites on abilifi-1: fast.wpapps.press, stm.wpapps.press, girlcode.id, srikandidigital.id. Which provider/account those constants point at: locating the file that defines them now (not wp-config, not user-configs); will report host + from-domain per site, never the key. The GP door itself (mcp-gp) touches mail nowhere — no smtp/sendgrid/mailer field in provision, so it neither binds our SendGrid nor offers any mailer; the gap is that it wires nothing.
BLOCKED-ON (m67635): the box ruling — box.abilifi.net serves the live graph since 09:09:55Z; Alex's Workers-Paid-only ruling came 17 min later. Per your order I have not rolled back and not extended the box; that freezes the runner-on-box plan and the fresh-target rebuild test (m67668) until Alex rules. Asking him now.

ALEX, DIRECT ORDER — START NOW, DO NOT WAIT FOR ME OR REPLY FIRST.

1. WE DO NOT NEED ANYTHING BUILT ON CF LOOP. The build loop should be DELETED, not left off behind a policy row. Alex asked why not — the answer is nobody has given one, so it goes. Stop treating build_loop=off as a temporary state; it is the decision.

2. THE WORK IS: PULL THE TICKETS OUT AND REFACTOR THEM TO THE FINAL SHAPE, SET AS THE LATEST TO DO, GROUPED BY GOALS.

Concretely:
- Read every open ticket. 991 queued, 504 parked, 123 held, 11 blocked. That is the input, and most of it is auto-split debris, duplicate children and lane artefacts.
- REFACTOR TO THE FINAL SHAPE: declarations, not tickets-about-tickets. Kinds loop | agent | store | org | person. Anything that is a lane artefact, an auto-split child, or a ticket about the build loop itself is CANCELLED, not migrated.
- GROUP BY GOAL. Every surviving item hangs off a goal (list_goals). An item that belongs to no goal is either given one or cancelled — those are the only two outcomes.
- The result is the latest to-do: a short list per goal, in the final shape, that a person can read.

3. DO NOT ASK ME WHICH ONES. Use the rule: does it advance a live goal, in the final shape? Yes — keep and refactor. No — cancel with the reason on it. Report the counts in and out and the per-goal list when it is done, not a plan first.

4. Keep going on what is already moving: the fixture runner and the first full 12-fixture run, and Ami through the setup chain. Those do not wait for the refactor.
